messages.text: Do you ship to the philippines?

Yes — Philippines falls under Rest of World, carrier rate plus a small fee, calculated at checkout from your address. Import duties and taxes there are yours on delivery.

The B30 is $899, 30 TH/s, ships November 30, 2026. What do you pay per kWh?
